title: [PC] Mad Max $4.49 (RRP $29.95) @ GOG
body:
Deal: [PC] Mad Max $4.49 (RRP $29.95) @ GOG

[CrispyChrispy] $2.50 AUD off Loaded for the Steam copy
And has been as low as $3.35 AUD off Gamebillet (an official store) only a few months ago
It's been hovering around this price for the last year and a half or so, so not too special of a deal imo
[FRD] $2.50 AUD off Loaded(loaded.com) for the Steam copy
True, but with GOG you actually own the files forever without being tied to a launcher or needing a storefront's permission to play them ( GOG's value proposition is very different ). Worth the small premium for a lot of people.
And has been as low as $3.35 AUD off Gamebillet (an official store) only a few months ago
Another Steam keys reseller. Also, you have to let the past go mate.
[CrispyChrispy] Gamebillet is not a keyshop/grey marketplace like Loaded, G2A, etc. Gamebillet is an official source
Fair call about the ownership/DRM side of it, but nevertheless good to let people know there are cheaper options out there for those who don't mind going through Steam
